entry.title: CVE-2026-18963 - Keycloak reset-credentials bypass → full account takeover

link.title: CVE-2026-18963 - Keycloak reset-credentials bypass → full account takeover

entry.summary: Unauthenticated full account takeover in Keycloak's reset-credentials flow (CVE-2026-18963, CVSS 9.1) - a sticky form-flag defect chained with an action-token check that never verifies the email link. Manual walkthrough plus a patched control.
